notes: Scanner and paper-saving update: quizzes up to 30 items now print as two complete cut-apart answer sheets on one US Letter / short-bond page. Each half-sheet has compact bubbles, four registration squares, and a QuickGrade form code. The full-screen camera shows a green outline around the form, corners, and code when detected, then waits for three stable readings before scoring. Older QuickGrade sheets and all locally saved data remain supported.
